items.title: Gridworks launches tender process for 460km Mozambique power transmission project
items.summary: Gridworks, the UK Government’s electricity grid investment platform British government-owned investor in Africa’s electricity networks,, has launched a pre-qualification process for contractors for a 460-kilometre power transmission project in Mozambique, valued at €386 million. According to the tender notice, which GW Mozambique Investments LLP, an affiliate of Gridworks, and Eletricidade de Moçambique (EDM) issued, and… Source
